title: Stop Repeating Yourself
look: Session board: chat bubbles, transcript cards and rule cards on a dot-grid desk. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion. The Sensei mark on the close.

scenes.name: Again
scenes.desc: You keep telling the AI the same thing: the same correction comes back, counted up.

scenes.name: Two reasons
scenes.desc: Two causes: the AI drifts into correction loops, or the ask is thin and it guesses.

scenes.name: Sensei reads
scenes.desc: Sensei reads the session transcript and picks out each follow-up that corrects the AI.

scenes.name: Repeats become rules
scenes.desc: Corrections from many sessions cluster into rules the AI loads at the start of the next session.

scenes.name: Thin asks
scenes.desc: The plan depth review checks a request against the bar; an adversarial review hunts what was missed.

scenes.name: Measured
scenes.desc: First-time results show whether a rule helped; a change that helps is kept.

scenes.name: Sensei
scenes.desc: End card with the Sensei mark: stop repeating yourself.
